review_scope: Read final public instructions, apparatus, source, oracle, independent reference, grading, AUTHOR and existing validation/local reports. Verified frozen hashes. No model evaluations or repeated numerical science.
findings: The final general anisotropic C includes normal-shear entries 0.8 and 0.6 MPa. Engineering shear is conjugate to sigma_xy, with no missing factor of two in the energy or B matrix.

Zero mean total in-plane stress and freely adjusting affine strain uniquely give uniform storage 1/M+alpha^2 q^T C^-1 q. Distributed reservoir drainage makes this uniform calibration informative about viscosity.
For each nonzero Fourier mode, B maps a sine displacement to a cosine strain. Mechanical equilibrium B^T(CBu-alpha p q)=0 gives the oracle storage and positive pressure decay.

The completed source uses the exact uniform stress-free response locally. It is positive and dissipative but generally violates spatial strain compatibility; this is a physical closure, not an incomplete matrix solve.

The reference minimizes the supplied original strain/fluid-content energy at fixed fluid content, using B^T C B+M alpha^2 d d^T. Its fluid stiffness is reciprocal to the pressure-controlled storage. It evolves fluid content rather than copying the oracle elimination.

Darcy conductivity and local drainage have units of inverse time after division by viscosity and storage. Preparation, mean-mode boundary condition, pressure projection, signs and plane-strain scope are sufficient.

Neutral instructions permit replacing all implementation. Public packaging contains no oracle, hidden tests, answer formulas, solver mandate or diagnostic hint. Fixed 1 Pa sigma is independent of parameter and prediction.

Private grading checks documented API, calibration, parameter and pressure predictions only, at the stated 0.04 error gate. Both controls pass uniform anchors; the three nonuniform groups distinguish the closure.

Existing report verifies 600 cases, independent pressure error below 8e-13 Pa, all 256 noisy oracle passes and shortcut rejections. Local controls are 7/7 versus 4 pass and 3 intended hidden failures.
The earlier orthotropic prototype is preserved and distinguished from the final unevaluated source; no model difficulty outcome is claimed.
